store = Path.home() / "Library/Application Support/Firmdura/kirkstone-sample"

targets = [

    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti112-bundles/bundles/firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-patched-eval-bundle.tar.gz", "aa04251544a1ff48e690620591255f029ca361871acc48af63ee785b462c8678"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti112-bundles/bundles/firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-corresponding-source.tar.gz", "ad8bded335da769b16cf66a4b3279e93e9667e6839c1dd82cce3f8a24c86c3ef"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti112-bundles/bundles/firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-licenses-and-notices.tar.gz", "351d071eae6de20bd95af40356ba98c353953e7fcfaa4129c4bb5a06c5f15a76"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti112-bundles/bundles/firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-redistribution-inventory.json", "e66a37683054d0c70963e6f171e271d2530fdcc0f793687fb4959d9e7d635427"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti109-reproduction/deploy.tar", "2c86ce06bb56f07c01eae0d3fee277adeb6ec487ed93c23e5d4bca53a437ba3b"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/deploy.tar", "7b53c6ea6a846b4182ec40134314d25f091b0b3a3cd2509922e13c5769e306e6"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/sbom/baseline-41pkg-consolidated.spdx.json", "050eb32b37945ded03465de1f1f178cb433d7a37c408ee1a0fc83327292e3765"),
    ("store", "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/sbom/patched-41pkg-consolidated.spdx.json", "f050a6e085b2c61afa3507cd35e977252f3fcf9836f91148c099189e20009110"),

]

records = []
for kind, rel, expected in targets:
    p = (store if kind == "store" else repo) / rel
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        actual = hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()
    size = p.stat().st_size

report = {"phase": "pre_replay", "verified_count": len(records), "all_matched": True, "files": records}
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

sti-115-seed-filtered-sstate
argv:
import json, os, shutil, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

src_ss = Path("/src/sstate-cache")
dst_ss = Path("/dst/sstate-cache")
excluded_tokens = ("libwebsockets", "firmdura-lws-h2-tests", "firmdura-reference-image")
copied_files = 0
excluded_files = []

for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src_ss):
    rel_root = Path(root).relative_to(src_ss)
    for f in files:
        fl = f.lower()
        rel_f = rel_root / f
        if any(tok in fl for tok in excluded_tokens):
            excluded_files.append(str(rel_f))
            continue
        target = dst_ss / rel_f
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(Path(root) / f, target)
        copied_files += 1

remaining = subprocess.check_output([
    "find", "/dst/sstate-cache",
    "(", "-iname", "*libwebsockets*", "-o", "-iname", "*firmdura-lws-h2-tests*", "-o", "-iname", "*firmdura-reference-image*", ")"
], text=True).strip()
assert remaining == "", f"Unexpected target sstate files remained: {remaining}"
assert not Path("/dst/downloads").exists(), "/dst/downloads should not exist before fresh build"
df_out = subprocess.check_output(["df", "-h", "/dst"], text=True).strip()
print(json.dumps({
    "copied_base_sstate_files": copied_files,
    "excluded_target_sstate_count": len(excluded_files),
    "excluded_target_sstate_sample": sorted(excluded_files)[:20],
    "remaining_matching_target_sstate": 0,
    "downloads_seeded": False,
    "df_after_seed": df_out,
}, indent=2))

commands.label: sti-115-manifest-and-redistribution-audit
argv:
import gzip, hashlib, json, re, tarfile
from pathlib import Path

store = Path.home() / "Library/Application Support/Firmdura/kirkstone-sample"
out_path = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti115-replay/engineering-redistribution-audit.json"
bundles_dir = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti112-bundles/bundles"

# 1. Manifest equality audit across frozen baseline, frozen patched, rebuilt baseline, rebuilt patched
def read_manifest_from_deploy(deploy_tar):
    with tarfile.open(deploy_tar, "r:") as tf:
        for m in tf.getmembers():
            if m.isfile() and m.name.startswith("deploy/images/qemuarm64/") and m.name.endswith(".rootfs.manifest"):
                txt = tf.extractfile(m).read().decode("utf-8")
                return m.name, hashlib.sha256(txt.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), [ln.strip() for ln in txt.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    raise RuntimeError(f"No manifest in {deploy_tar}")

fb_name, fb_sha, fb_lines = read_manifest_from_deploy(store / "artifacts/20261118-sti109-reproduction/deploy.tar")
fp_name, fp_sha, fp_lines = read_manifest_from_deploy(store / "artifacts/20261118-sti110-patched/deploy.tar")
rb_info = json.loads((store / "artifacts/20261118-sti115-replay/rebuilt-baseline-inspection.json").read_text())
rp_info = json.loads((store / "artifacts/20261118-sti115-replay/rebuilt-patched-inspection.json").read_text())

assert len(fb_lines) == 41 and len(fp_lines) == 41
assert fb_sha == rb_info["manifest_sha256"], (fb_sha, rb_info["manifest_sha256"])
assert fp_sha == rp_info["manifest_sha256"], (fp_sha, rp_info["manifest_sha256"])

fb_pkgs = {ln.split()[0]: tuple(ln.split()) for ln in fb_lines}
fp_pkgs = {ln.split()[0]: tuple(ln.split()) for ln in fp_lines}
assert set(fb_pkgs.keys()) == set(fp_pkgs.keys())
diffs = {k: {"baseline": fb_pkgs[k], "patched": fp_pkgs[k]} for k in sorted(fb_pkgs) if fb_pkgs[k] != fp_pkgs[k]}
assert set(diffs.keys()) == {"libwebsockets-evlib-uv", "libwebsockets-testapps", "libwebsockets18"}, diffs

# 2. Redistribution inventory, corresponding-source.tar.gz, licenses-and-notices.tar.gz audit
inv = json.loads((bundles_dir / "firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-redistribution-inventory.json").read_text())

src_tar = bundles_dir / "firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-corresponding-source.tar.gz"
lic_tar = bundles_dir / "firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-licenses-and-notices.tar.gz"
base_bundle = bundles_dir / "firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-baseline-eval-bundle.tar.gz"
patch_bundle = bundles_dir / "firmdura-kirkstone-qemuarm64-patched-eval-bundle.tar.gz"

def audit_targz(path, check_text_leaks=False):
    members = {}
    leaks = []
    secret_re = re.compile(r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]+|lin_api_[A-Za-z0-9]+|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY")
    with tarfile.open(path, "r:gz") as tf:
        for m in tf.getmembers():
            assert not m.name.startswith("/") and ".." not in m.name.split("/"), m.name
            assert m.isfile(), f"Expected regular file in deterministic bundle {path.name}: {m.name}"
            data = tf.extractfile(m).read()
            members[m.name] = {"size": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
            if check_text_leaks and not m.name.endswith((".bin", ".ext4", ".tar.xz", ".tar.gz", ".tar.bz2")):
                txt = data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                if "<macos-users-root>/" in txt or "<linux-user-home>" in txt or secret_re.search(txt):
                    leaks.append(m.name)
    assert not leaks, f"Host path or secret leak in {path.name}: {leaks}"
    return members

src_members = audit_targz(src_tar, check_text_leaks=True)
lic_members = audit_targz(lic_tar, check_text_leaks=True)
base_bundle_members = audit_targz(base_bundle, check_text_leaks=True)
patch_bundle_members = audit_targz(patch_bundle, check_text_leaks=True)

assert len(src_members) == 367, len(src_members)
assert len(lic_members) == 152, len(lic_members)

# Verify case-distinct bzip2 LICENSE.txt and License.txt both exist in lic_members
bzip2_lic_upper = [k for k in lic_members if k.endswith("/bzip2/LICENSE.txt") or ("bzip2" in k and k.endswith("/LICENSE.txt"))]
bzip2_lic_mixed = [k for k in lic_members if k.endswith("/bzip2/License.txt") or ("bzip2" in k and k.endswith("/License.txt"))]
# Check all case-colliding paths in lic_members!
by_lower = {}
for k in lic_members:
    by_lower.setdefault(k.lower(), []).append(k)
case_distinct_pairs = {lk: v for lk, v in by_lower.items() if len(v) > 1}

# Verify offline glibc-2.35 tarball and both libwebsockets variants + patches in corresponding-source
glibc_members = [k for k in src_members if "glibc-2.35" in k]
lws_members = sorted(k for k in src_members if "libwebsockets" in k)
assert any("bb59339d02faebac534a87eea50c83c948f35b77" in k or k.endswith(".tar.gz") for k in glibc_members), glibc_members
assert any("CVE-2026-19773-1.patch" in k for k in lws_members), lws_members
assert any("CVE-2026-19773-2.patch" in k for k in lws_members), lws_members

# Verify every source/license archive path referenced in redistribution-inventory.json exists and matches sha256!
inv_text = json.dumps(inv)
assert "<macos-users-root>/" not in inv_text and "<linux-user-home>" not in inv_text

# Check package coverage in redistribution-inventory.json
verified_pkg_mappings = 0
for variant_key in ("baseline", "patched"):
    pkgs = inv["variants"][variant_key]["packages"]
    assert len(pkgs) == 41, (variant_key, len(pkgs))
    for pkg in pkgs:
        for sm in pkg["source_members"]:
            p = sm["path"] if isinstance(sm, dict) else sm
            assert p in src_members, f"Missing source member {p} for {pkg}"
            if isinstance(sm, dict) and "sha256" in sm:
                assert src_members[p]["sha256"] == sm["sha256"]
        for lm in pkg["license_members"]:
            p = lm["path"] if isinstance(lm, dict) else lm
            assert p in lic_members, f"Missing license member {p} for {pkg}"
            if isinstance(lm, dict) and "sha256" in lm:
                assert lic_members[p]["sha256"] == lm["sha256"]
        verified_pkg_mappings += 1

summary = {
    "manifest_equality": {
        "package_count_baseline": 41,
        "package_count_patched": 41,
        "frozen_and_rebuilt_baseline_manifest_sha256_identical": fb_sha,
        "frozen_and_rebuilt_patched_manifest_sha256_identical": fp_sha,
        "identical_packages_count": 38,
        "changed_packages": diffs,
    },
    "redistribution_audit": {
        "corresponding_source_member_count": len(src_members),
        "licenses_and_notices_member_count": len(lic_members),
        "baseline_eval_bundle_member_count": len(base_bundle_members),
        "patched_eval_bundle_member_count": len(patch_bundle_members),
        "verified_variant_package_mappings": verified_pkg_mappings,
        "glibc_source_members": glibc_members,
        "libwebsockets_source_members": lws_members,
        "case_distinct_license_paths": case_distinct_pairs,
        "zero_host_paths_or_secrets": True,
    },
}
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

commands.label: sti-115-post-input-hashes
argv:
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

store = Path.home() / "Library/Application Support/Firmdura/kirkstone-sample"
repo = Path.cwd()
pre = json.loads((store / "artifacts/20261118-sti115-replay/pre-replay-frozen-hashes.json").read_text())
out_path = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti115-replay/post-replay-frozen-hashes.json"

post_files = []
for entry in pre["files"]:
    rel = entry["relative_path"]
    p = (repo / rel) if entry["locator"].startswith("<checkout>/") else (store / rel)
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        actual = hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()
    size = p.stat().st_size
    assert actual == entry["sha256"] and size == entry["size"], f"Mutation detected on {rel}: {actual} vs {entry}"
    post_files.append({**entry, "post_sha256": actual, "post_size": size, "immutable_verified": True})

report = {"phase": "post_replay", "verified_count": len(post_files), "all_immutable": True, "files": post_files}
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"phase": "post_replay", "verified_count": len(post_files), "all_immutable": True}, indent=2))
